fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance on the NE side off Little Hearst Pkwy. Street View (pano cnLRlAnQsxxOWFsZNErvBA, 2025-12, heading ~135) shows the entrance apron with concrete jersey barriers, signage panels and a check-in kiosk/call-box pole. Whole 154-acre property is fenced with a continuous treeline buffer; trucks cannot reach docks without passing this pinch point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth-sized structure could be positively resolved at the entrance: the actual check-in point sits beyond the public-road treeline, outside Street View reach, and no guard-booth footprint is visible in satellite at the apron. Called false with low confidence; a staffed booth set back inside the gate cannot be ruled out.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true as the complement of truckGate=true with no visible guard shack (kiosk/call-box pole seen at the apron implies remote/automated check-in). Flagged uncertain alongside guardShack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door band runs the full ~1000+ ft south face of the building with trailers backed in along its entire length; far into the 50+ band. Door count ~120 is an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large dedicated drop yard south of the dock apron with many angled trailer rows (50+ band). Capacity ~250 trailers estimated from striped stalls.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved truck court between the gate/apron and the dock face provides ample internal holding before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long NE approach drive from the public road wrapping to the truck court holds well more than 3 trucks of stacking depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and ample paved width at the entrance leave physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Gate apron width supports ~2 inbound lanes; exact lane striping not resolvable in Street View — estimate.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated single outbound lane; not directly resolvable.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park (Savannah River International Trade Park, Port Wentworth) surrounded by woods, marsh and a tidal creek; per rubric, small-town/edge-of-town industrial = Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; access is road-only off Little Hearst Pkwy (port-drayage import DC).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter polygon yields 154.3 acres, matching the Chatham County assessor land size of 6,534,000 sq ft (~150 acres) for 211 Little Hearst Pkwy (Target), confirming correct building identification.
fieldNotes.buildingId: Confirmed as Target's 2,048,125 sq ft import distribution warehouse (built 2006, opened 2007) at 211 Little Hearst Pkwy, Savannah/Port Wentworth GA 31407 — distinct from the adjacent smaller IKEA DC at 202 Little Hearst Pkwy (750,480 sq ft). Provided address '110' and geocoded point were off; corrected via assessor land-area match.
